# We rethink packaging every day.

We are Constantia Flexibles, a global leader in consumer and pharmaceutical flexible packaging.

[Find out more][30]

## Pharma Business

Together with our partners, we protect health and ensure the safety of patients and their loved
ones.

[About Pharma][31]

## Consumer Business

We aim to provide people with the highest benefit daily at the lowest impact on the environment.

[About Consumer][32]

## People Passion Packaging

Based on the guiding principle of People Passion Packaging, we globally manufacture tailor-made
flexible packaging solutions.

## We Design for Recycling

With more than 110 years of experience in flexible packaging, we know that high‑quality and visually
appealing packaging is only part of the story. Today, packaging also needs to work within modern
recycling systems and meet evolving customer expectations.


That’s why we apply Design for Recycling principles across our development processes. Our
**Ecolutions portfolio** includes flexible packaging solutions engineered to support established
recycling streams wherever possible. These products are designed to perform strongly, protect goods,
and be handled more efficiently at end‑of‑life within available infrastructure.
 

By continuously improving material choices, design features, and production technologies, we help
customers move toward packaging that aligns with the requirements of tomorrow’s markets.

Jobs & Career

## Your career at Constantia Flexibles

No matter if you want to start or to further develop in your career, Constantia Flexibles offers
meaningful jobs that contribute to a better tomorrow, creating packaging solutions that protect
goods and the environment and save lives. Explore our job opportunities and learn more about us.

[Career at Constantia][33]

## Explore our culture

At Constantia Flexibles, we are passionate about what we do and want to play a part in making
tomorrow’s world a better place. Find out more about our culture, our core values and whom do we
seek on board.

[ Learn more ][34]

## Job openings

Join us and unwrap your talent!

[ Apply ][35]

and dies.

A well-designed custom package is more than just protection - it's a marketing tool that creates a
memorable unboxing experience. Adding your logo, brand colors and messaging to your packaging
enhances brand visbility, reinforces your identity, and sets your product apart.

Professionally printed boxes convey attention to detail and build trust with your customers. With
the right custom package design, your packaging can tell your brand story, generate social buzz,
enhance [brand visibility][70] and even turn customers into loyal advocates.

## **BEAUTY FORMULATIONS**

HCT's R+D team collaborates with the most outstanding labs in Asia, Europe, and North America, to
create exceptional formulas that range from color to skincare. We have a global footprint for
research, development, and formulation, helping clients get to market faster.

[CONTACT US][35]

## **ACCESSORIES**

HCT Accessories specializes in creating premium quality beauty tools and solutions that fall into
the many segments of the cosmetics industry. Choose from a unique library of advanced materials,
customizable finishes, and decorative options.

[Brushes & Applicators][36]
[Beauty Tools][37]

## MANUFACTURING

HCT has manufacturing plants worldwide, ensuring excellence in quality and speed to market. We
conduct thorough vetting and Social Compliance Auditing of all factories and trusted partner
vendors. HCT's global footprint makes it easy to source best in class materials and tap into cutting
edge technologies and global cultural influences.

[CONTACT US][40]

## THE HCT PROCESS

### > Concept Development & Design

Our relationship with customers begins with total collaboration – through the development and design
process, our R+D and Sales teams find the best solutions to deliver on your goals. Customers can
choose from our extensive range of existing packaging or work with us to create a completely custom
design. Or take advantage of one of the world’s most comprehensive and evolving stock libraries by
combining our stock component parts with a newly designed custom piece. Our in-house team of expert
designers is unparalleled when it comes to innovative cosmetics packaging. In addition to
specializing in industrial design and engineering, we also offer graphic design, package
brainstorming, formula conceptualization, and formula R+D to tap into the most innovative
technologies and global cultural influences.

### > Manufacturing

We live at the forefront of innovation, delivering packaging and product development coupled with
vertically integrated testing and manufacturing capabilities. HCT controls eight manufacturing
facilities and has strict audit requirements for all vendors. This allows us to deliver exceptional
solutions to clients for cost effectiveness, efficiencies across the board, and regionalization.
Lean on us for the world’s most extensive selection of stock packaging options, or collaborate with
us on custom tooling, custom formulation, shade matching, state-of-the-art decorating and finishing,
and quality control. With a portfolio that expands year over year, the possibilities with HCT Group
are infinite.

### > Fill & Assembly

Flexibility is key when finding the best product for your brand. We provide our customers with the
option to choose formulas from the United States, Italy, China, Korea or Japan. Our fill and
assembly factories provide cost effective and timely solutions for clients.

### > Logistics & Operations

Once we’ve built the product of your dreams, we won’t just walk away. We offer full-service
integrated logistics and operational support to help you get on shelves faster. Our team of experts
can support all aspects of your product launch including organizing US customs/FDA Clearance,
foreign-to-foreign shipping, sea, air, and domestic tracking as well as managing foreign imports and
exports. Because we bring our partners unique, groundbreaking products unlike anything else on the
market, implementing strict testing and compliance is important to us. We offer compatibility
testing, stability testing, regulatory assistance, finished goods QA/QC, and documentation
management and procurement.

## About DELE

Our company adheres to the "people-oriented" philosophy and the purpose of "quality and integrity"
to serve our customers. 

Our company has become one of the leading companies in the national non-woven fabric processing
equipment industry. 

We are a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, manufacturing and sales of
non-woven fabric processing equipment. 
* Jiangxi Dele Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 2010.
* The company now is located in Dexing High-tech Industrial Park, with a total investment of about
  150 million RMB.
* The total land of factory around 50 acres, a plant area of workshop more than 30, 000 square
  meters.
* We have 12 standard production workshops, equipped with CNC machining workshops, spare parts
  warehouses, and assembly Production workshop, etc.

## Creating experiences through packaging.

# Welcome to
# Merchant Boxes.

[Hands working on product design sketches and blueprints spread across a table, with model boxes and
design tools around.]

## If you can imagine it, we can make it.

Packaging can be a major brand differentiator. Merchant Boxes is a partner for brands and
organizations large and small that want to get the most out of their packaging and in-home brand
experiences.

We design and supply the highest **quality** **packaging**, through one of the **largest global
sourcing networks** on the planet, designing, sourcing, and producing impactful **brand
experiences**.

# Custom Packaging

# Custom Packaging

[Packaging design for a natural cosmetics brand, featuring a teal-colored box with a white leaf logo
and text that reads 'Your Brand, All Natural,' placed on a gold tray. There are two tubes of similar
design and some grey-green leaves around the tray on a white surface.]

Custom packaging isn't just about aesthetics; it's a strategic tool that impacts customer
perception, loyalty, and business growth.

1. **First Impressions Matter**: Just like meeting someone new, the first impression you make with
your product matters. Within seconds, customers form opinions about your brand. Imagine delivering
your product in a plain, unbranded box—what does that say about your brand? Consistent,
well-designed custom packaging reinforces your brand identity and sets the stage for a positive
experience.

2. **Reinforces Your Brand**: Custom packaging is often the first touchpoint outside of your
website. It reaffirms why customers chose your product in the first place. By bringing your unique
selling proposition onto your packaging, you signal to customers that they should buy from you
again. It's a way to say, "This is us, and we're worth coming back to!"

3. **Differentiation**: In a sea of generic packaging, customized packaging allows your brand to
stand out. It differentiates your product from competitors and highlights its advantages. When
customers see your distinct packaging, they associate it with your brand and remember you more
readily.

4. **Enhances Customer Experience**: Custom packaging contributes to the overall customer journey.
It's not just about the product—it's about the entire experience. If you've invested in a seamless
online experience, don't let it fall flat with lackluster packaging. Consistency matters and custom
packaging ensures that your brand story continues beyond the website.

5. **Marketing and Branding**: Tailoring packaging to your unique needs strengthens your connection
with customers. It's an essential element of modern marketing. When done right, it communicates
quality, care, and attention to detail. Remember, your packaging speaks volumes about your brand!

## The **data **on custom packaging **speaks** for itself.

**72%**

[Close-up of a black and white guitar with an electric guitar body, strings, and tuning pegs
visible.]

In the US alone, [72% of consumers][35] make purchasing decisions based on packaging design.

**70%**

[Forbes logo in black text on a transparent background]

[60–80% of consumers][36] do not go back to the same business even if they were satisfied with the
product. If there is no experience, no “wow” factor in their wider product experience.

**61%**

[A computer monitor displaying a graph, a keyboard, and a mouse on a desk]

[61% of consumers ][37]say they are much more likely to repeat a purchase of a luxury product if it
came in premium packaging.

**52%**

[Empty black background with a white arrow pointing left.]

[52% of consumers][38] have changed product brands to new packaging designs.

[Graphic design promoting the Package Design Podcast, sponsored by Merchant Boxes, featuring bold
black text 'unboxed' over a blue and white geometric background.]

## SOFT-CEL® Candy Pads

Protect delicate confections with decorative, multi-ply pads available in custom shapes, colors, and
ply options—engineered for both function and elegance.

[View More Details][33]

## SOFT-CEL® Cushioning

Eco-friendly padding made from recycled materials, providing soft yet strong protection for a wide
range of food and retail products.

[View More Details][34]

## Folding Cartons

Durable, brand-ready cartons designed for product protection and shelf appeal—customized to your
dimensions, printing, and finishing needs.

[View More Details][35]

## Paperboard Trays

Precision die-cut trays that offer structural support for packaging inserts or displays – custom
built for stability, presentation and superior machinability.

[View More Details][36]

## Slit Roll Stock

High-performance slit rollstock engineered for automated lines – available in coated or uncoated
paperboard and ideal for use as base cards, U-boards, or layers across a range of packaging
applications.

[View More Details][37]

## “U” Boards, Base Cards & Layers

U-boards, Base Cards and Layer Boards cut with precision and consistency. Available in virgin or
recycled and with coated or uncoated finishes to best suit your product and production needs.

[View More Details][38]

## Specialty Paper

FDA-approved glassine, parchment, and Quilon papers tailored for food-safe use and available in
custom sizes and finishes.

[View More Details][39]

## Candy Cups, Wax Paper & Assembled Partitions

Everything you need to separate, protect, and present your confections—from individual cups to wax
liners and hand-assembled partitions.

[View More Details][40]

At Packagingdotcom, we offer a wide range of packaging solutions, including packaging materials such
as corrugated boxes, custom-printed boxes, paper bags, and wrapping paper. Additionally, we provide

unique requirements.

Absolutely! We take pride in offering personalized packaging solutions. Whether you need a unique
design, specific dimensions, or branded packaging, our team of experts will work closely with you to
bring your vision to life. Get in touch with us to discuss your custom packaging needs.

Placing an order with Packagingdotcom is simple and convenient. You can reach out to our sales team
through our website, email, or phone, and they will guide you through the ordering process. Once we
understand your requirements, we will provide you with a detailed quote, and upon your approval, we
will proceed with production.

We offer multiple secure payment options to ensure a seamless transaction process. You can pay for
your orders using credit cards, debit cards, online bank transfers, or other electronic payment
methods. Our team will guide you through the payment process to make it hassle-free for you.

# **Founded in 1975, Packaging Personified is a leader in the flexible packaging industry.**

## Our Story

In 1975, our founders Dominic Imburgia and Phyllis Muccianti sat at a kitchen table and created a
flexible packaging business. After leaving Sears, they used their packaging experience to coordinate
and procure flexible packaging for third-party use. As entrepreneurs, and firm believers in quality
and service, they began their business at that same kitchen table. Within four months, their
business needed more room to grow.

[ Learn More ][34]
[DANIEL KELLEGHAN PHOTOGRAPHY-5492.jpg]

## Capabilities

Since our founding in 1975 our capabilities have expanded each year. Our goal of vertical
integration has provided us with the ability to better manage quality, service and cost relative to
our competitors.

[Learn More][35]
 
[_CCC4499.jpg]

## Products

Packaging Personified serves industry leaders with our flexible packaging, graphics proofing and
separation, extrusion, printing, converting, lamination, and laser perforation, all done from our
multiple manufacturing locations in the center of the United States. Our custom packaging has
continuously proven, over decades, to be superior in quality and price. By working directly with our
clients, we understand your specific needs and expectations. Whether large or small, we have the
flexibility to handle your packaging needs.

[Learn More][36]

# **Founded in 1975, Packaging Personified is a leader in the flexible packaging industry.**

## Our Story

In 1975, our founders Dominic Imburgia and Phyllis Muccianti sat at a kitchen table and created a
flexible packaging business. After leaving Sears, they used their packaging experience to coordinate
and procure flexible packaging for third-party use. As entrepreneurs, and firm believers in quality
and service, they began their business at that same kitchen table. Within four months, their
business needed more room to grow.

[ Learn More ][34]
[DANIEL KELLEGHAN PHOTOGRAPHY-5492.jpg]

## Capabilities

Since our founding in 1975 our capabilities have expanded each year. Our goal of vertical
integration has provided us with the ability to better manage quality, service and cost relative to
our competitors.

[Learn More][35]
 
[_CCC4499.jpg]

## Products

Packaging Personified serves industry leaders with our flexible packaging, graphics proofing and
separation, extrusion, printing, converting, lamination, and laser perforation, all done from our
multiple manufacturing locations in the center of the United States. Our custom packaging has
continuously proven, over decades, to be superior in quality and price. By working directly with our
clients, we understand your specific needs and expectations. Whether large or small, we have the
flexibility to handle your packaging needs.

  [question mark icon] Top FAQs [Explore all FAQs][7]
  * What happens after I place my order? Do I get a proof before printing?
    
    After checkout, our dedicated Prepress team will review your design for any technical concerns
    and send a 2D digital proof of your custom boxes to your email within 24 hours. If any changes
    need to be made, you can send a note directly to our Prepress team through the proof page and
    they'll be happy to help with finalizing your design for printing.
  * How do I know if my art is printable?
    
    Our dedicated in-house Prepress team will review your custom box design for any technical
    concerns (artwork resolution, blurriness, splits, thin lines, and bleeds) and if found, will
    note them for your attention in the proof. If you're unsure of how to fix any printing concerns
    that are noted, our Prepress representatives are happy to help you through the process. It's
    important to keep in mind that our team does not check for spelling or grammar errors, nor do
    they provide any subjective feedback on design content.
  * What is the turnaround time on my order?
    
    Our Standard turnaround for most custom packaging orders is around 10 business days and Rush
    turnaround is 7 business days. These turnarounds do not include transit time (1 - 7 business
    days depending on your location). Special custom or bulk orders may require a few extra days to
    get setup and produced. Please note that during extremely busy times of year some orders may
    take longer to complete. While delivery estimates cannot be guaranteed, all dates shown at
    checkout are the quickest estimate we offer. If your delivery date is time sensitive, we highly
    recommend choosing Rush production and expedited shipping for your box orders.
  * Can I get an instant quote for my order?
    
    Yes, you can select your size, material, and quantity on our free 3D design tool to instantly
    view a quote for your project. As you upload artwork, add text, or color the background in each
    panel of the 3D model, you'll see your Unit Price update in real-time.
  * Can you print inside the boxes?
    
    Yes! We can print on the inside of any of our corrugated box styles. This includes Mailers,
    Shipping Boxes, and Tuck Tops (our secret menu product!). Product Boxes are currently limited to
    printing on the exterior only. You can even use our online box designer to design the inside of
    your custom boxes. For Shippers and Tuck Tops, we currently require a 2D dieline template be
    submitted for both the interior and exterior so we can set up your order as a custom order. You
    can also submit designs this way for our Mailer boxes, if you prefer to build on a 2D
    Illustrator template instead of our free 3D box design tool.
  * How to get a dieline?
    
    If you prefer to work in 2D to create your design in Adobe Illustrator (or another tool outside
    of our website), we recommend using a dieline template. For corrugated and cardstock boxes, you
    can download a free template from the artwork upload page or within our online design studio.
    For our other products, dielines are available for download from the template section of the
    product detail page.

A:

We manufacture all our products in the United States. Based on the order specifications and shipping
ZIP code, we pick a facility that yields the best result.

Q: Do you check my artwork for technical issues like alignment and image resolution?

all corrections and edits for transparency. However, we will not be responsible for misspellings or
incorrect content once printing begins.

Q: How can I reorder?
A:

checkout and place your order.

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging

## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

Un’importante realtà aziendale che da oltre vent’anni opera nella comunicazione visiva e nei
molteplici aspetti ad essa collegati.
* CREATIVA con soluzioni sempre innovative
* FLESSIBILE per adattarsi ad ogni esigenza
* GIOVANE come lo spirito ribelle del suo team
* INNOVATIVA e sempre alla ricerca di nuove idee
* EFFICENTE nella pianificazione di ogni attività

### Soddisfare visioni, superare aspettative

Seven Group è un team di esperti che mettono in campo il loro know-how per sviluppare progetti
unici. Con un team di creativi, tecnici, allestitori e montatori siamo in grado di trasformare idee

nell’ambito dell’[allestimento vetrina][22], del [packaging][23], degli [espositori][24] e di tutti
quei prodotti destinati alla promozione del brand e dell’immagine aziendale.

I nostri obiettivi principali sono la CUSTOMER SATISFACTION e la CUSTOMER LOYALTY per questo motivo
ogni giorno cerchiamo soluzioni innovative attraverso la ricerca di nuovi materiali, selezionati di
volta in volta in base al tipo di progetto.

La creatività è il nostro asso nella manica, il nostro team di grafici sperimenta e realizza
progetti sempre unici. La fedeltà del cliente è un valore che consideriamo essenziale; la fiducia
che ci accordano e la collaborazione a lungo termine sono indicatori preziosi del nostro impegno
efficace ed efficiente.

# O společnosti

**Ve společnosti Stavounie-CZ, s.r.o. ****již více než**** 35 let n****avrhujeme a vyrábíme
spolehlivá, nákladově efektivní a udržitelná obalová řešení pro** **bezpečnou
přepravu**** ****výrobků a produktů** všeho druhu kamkoliv na světě –** po souši, po moři i
letecky.**

**Vyrábíme [exportní obaly][43],** [**zámořské obaly**][44] (s možností balení [**přímo** **u
zákazníka**][45]), **dřevěné [přepravní bedny][46]** **s** [**IPPC/ISPM 15**][47]
**certifikací****,** [**atypické palety**][48] **na míru** **i** **další ochranné a přepravní
obaly** ze dřeva, překližky, OSB a dalších materiálů.

Součástí našeho portfolia jsou také **specializovaná obalová řešení** **pro ochranu** [**citlivých
zařízení a výrobků **][49]**v** **energetice,** **lehkém i těžkém průmyslu,** **letectví** **a
obranném sektoru** (například** ****elektrické rozvaděče,** **turbíny, avionika** **a drony,
proudové** **motory, vojenská** **technika** a další).

**Pro zajištění optimální ochrany** tyto obaly doplňujeme o** speciální výplně na míru, pěnové
vložky a polstrování, i přesné CNC obráběné podpěry a fixační prvky,** které zajišťují **dokonalé
usazení výrobku** a **maximální ochranu** během **manipulace, přepravy a skladování.**

**Díky vlastním výrobním, skladovým a manipulačním prostorům** **o rozloze přes ****45.000 m²,
špičkovému technologickému vybavení** a **komplexní logistické infrastruktuře** (včetně **vlastního
vozového parku,** těžkotonážních VZV a halových jeřábů) realizujeme zakázky všech velikostí.** Od
jednorázových kusových řešení **až po **sériové dodávky s denními návozy.**

**Jsme certifikovaní** dle [**ISO 9001:2015**][50] a [**IPPC/ISPM 15**][51], čímž **garantujeme
bezpečnost a plnou exportní kompatibilitu našich obalů pro celosvětový vývoz.** Současně do obalů
**integrujeme prvky [udržitelnosti][52] a společenské odpovědnosti** ve formě [**PEFC
certifikovaného dřeva**][53] **z udržitelného lesnictví,** používání **recyklovaných** a
**recyklovatelných materiálů,** naplňování **ESG standardů** a kontinuálního **snižování uhlíkové
stopy.**

**Spolehněte se navíce než 35 let zkušeností v oboru výroby ochranných a exportních obalů a
kontaktujte nás nezávazně ještě dnes**. Rádi vyslechneme vaše požadavky a společně najdeme **ideální
obalové řešení pro vaše potřeby – spolehlivé, nákladově efektivní a udržitelné.** [**Nezávazně
poptat!**][54]

 **1. ****Spolehlivost a špičková kvalita** – více než 35 let zkušeností v oblasti výroby exportních
a dřevěných obalů.

Your custom packaging ships directly to wherever you need it – eliminating logistics complexity and

## What Are Custom Boxes? – Overview

Custom boxes are made-to-order packaging built around your product specifications. Instead of
adjusting your products to standard sizes, we define the style, internal dimensions, material, and
print based on what you sell.

**With custom boxes, you can:**
* Match the internal dimensions to your product so it stays secure and protected.
* Print your logo, product details, and barcodes exactly where needed.
* Select board strength based on your product weight and shipping requirements.
* Use inserts or dividers when packing multiple items in one box.

### WHO IS ZAJAC

Zajac was established in 1975 as a mechanical contractor providing high purity process systems to
the dairy industry.  Since then we have grown based on the founding principles of quality
workmanship, process expertise, teamwork and dedication to customer service.  We now employ over 90
employees with offices in Maine and New Hampshire and customers across the US.  Our expertise
includes process knowledge in Food, Dairy, Beverage, Pharmaceutical and Personal care industries. 
Our capabilities include Process and Packaging Engineering, Automation, CAD design, Project
Management, Skid Fabrication, Process Piping, Electrical Engineering and installation and
calibration.

Please contact us for more information!

### Dairy

Zajac has over 40 years experience designing and fabricating dairy systems. Our experienced team of
process engineers and project managers are experts in sanitary design, CIP integration, 3-A
compliance and PMO regulations.

Typical systems include:
* HTST/UHT Pasteurization
* Aseptic Systems
* CIP Systems
* Blending and Fortification
* CIP / COP System
* Dry Ingredient Addition
* Mixproof Valve Matrixes
* HTST Legal Valve Controls

### BREWING

Zajac is a leading supplier to the Craft Brewing Industry. We are a custom design build firm with
the technical support and resources available to make your brewing project a success. We provide
process, mechanical and Utility services.

Typical systems and installations include:
* Brewhouse Installations
* Glycol Systems
* Chiller installations
* Fermentation Tank Installations
* Filtration piping
* Process Skidded Systems
* Valve Manifolds
* CIP Systems

modifications and greenfield process plant design we have the experience and resources to deliver a
successful project.

engineers, electricians, programmers and fabricators are experts in finding solutions to difficult
processing and packaging applications. We work very closely with our clients to support their

start-up, our field installation and calibration service department is available 24 hrs/day to
handle emergencies and planned shut downs.

from the incoming ingredients to finish packaging products.

## An End-to-end Creative Packaging Solution

Packaging is part of the product. It’s the first tangible brand connection. Our experience-driven
design narrates your product, revealing layers of meaning in your brand story. Through award-winning
design, state-of-the-art manufacturing, and intelligent logistics, we create and produce the most
innovative [custom packaging solutions][50].

### [ Strategy][51]

[][52]

We offer design strategy insights across fields such as custom packaging design, sustainability,
brand-system packaging, PR packaging and swag curation, packaging engineering, and emerging
materials.

### [ Design][53]

[][54]

Our branding, graphic, and structural design experts build custom packaging from the ground
up—balancing premium aesthetics, sustainable material selection, and structural engineering.

### [ Manufacturing][55]

[[Workers operating large blue printing machinery for package manufacturing in an industrial
facility.][Workers operating large blue printing machinery for package manufacturing in an
industrial facility.]][56]

We transform complex designs into precise, production-ready manufacturing blueprints. From sourcing
to rapid lab prototyping, we validate every structure down to the Golden Sample, ensuring flawless
execution during high-volume mass production.

### [ Logistics][57]

[[Conveyor system moving boxes within a packaging logistics warehouse with storage racks in the
background.][Conveyor system moving boxes within a packaging logistics warehouse with storage racks
in the background.]][58]

We simplify complex global supply chains by anchoring your logistics under one roof. Zenpack’s
network spans critical trade routes across North America, Southeast Asia, and Central America. We
handle everything from state-of-the-art container optimization and package kitting to strict retail
channel compliance.

## An End-to-end Creative Packaging Solution

Packaging is part of the product. It’s the first tangible brand connection. Our experience-driven
design narrates your product, revealing layers of meaning in your brand story. Through award-winning
design, state-of-the-art manufacturing, and intelligent logistics, we create and produce the most
innovative [custom packaging solutions][50].

### [ Strategy][51]

[][52]

We offer design strategy insights across fields such as custom packaging design, sustainability,
brand-system packaging, PR packaging and swag curation, packaging engineering, and emerging
materials.

### [ Design][53]

[][54]

Our branding, graphic, and structural design experts build custom packaging from the ground
up—balancing premium aesthetics, sustainable material selection, and structural engineering.

### [ Manufacturing][55]

[[Workers operating large blue printing machinery for package manufacturing in an industrial
facility.][Workers operating large blue printing machinery for package manufacturing in an
industrial facility.]][56]

We transform complex designs into precise, production-ready manufacturing blueprints. From sourcing
to rapid lab prototyping, we validate every structure down to the Golden Sample, ensuring flawless
execution during high-volume mass production.

### [ Logistics][57]

[[Conveyor system moving boxes within a packaging logistics warehouse with storage racks in the
background.][Conveyor system moving boxes within a packaging logistics warehouse with storage racks
in the background.]][58]

We simplify complex global supply chains by anchoring your logistics under one roof. Zenpack’s
network spans critical trade routes across North America, Southeast Asia, and Central America. We
handle everything from state-of-the-art container optimization and package kitting to strict retail
channel compliance.
